svg.title: TornadoGCM end-to-end system flow
svg.desc: Distributed training and production inference around a shared PZHA model step, with the SDA precision governance plane.
svg.text: PyTorch NeuralGCM · PZHA precision zones · SDA control plane · distributed training · production inference
1 batch → 2 forward K steps → 3 PZHA model step → 4 loss + all-reduce → 5 checkpoint → 6 rollout → 7 precision hot-swap → 8 failure recovery
distributed · K-step rollout · DDP / FSDP / DTensor
SHARED MODEL STEP · one rank's view
train + infer share this step · diamonds = zone casts
chunked rollout · NaN guard / rollback · Zarr output
NCCL all-reduce · ring / tree · Σ gradients
host policy applied at GPU zone boundaries
State placement: GPU HBM = model shards / activations / grads · host DRAM = batch prefetch · disk = ERA5 / checkpoint / forecast
